text:
Noelle: Opening a small PR to merge three Console observability snippets into one compact guide: heatmap wiring, tracehook header fallbacks, and a short migration blurb. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/18222
DocsBot: docs-bot: PR 18222 opened by Noelle. Lint and CI queued.
Ibrahim: I'll take the Node + TypeScript snippets. Plan to show header precedence (trace_key -> x-rd-trace -> x-forwarded-trace) and a helper that tries base64 then hex decode.
Hannah: I'll handle the Python example and a tiny pytest that checks the fallback behavior and bucket mapping formula.
Priya: UX note: dashboards now split routing_ms and decode_ms; migration guidance should tell customers to sum the two for legacy comparisons and call out p90/p99 separation. Also add a short Dedicated billing caveat about temporary reallocation when bucket resolution increases.
Noelle: Node helper idea:
```js
function resolveTrace(headers) {
  const raw = headers['trace_key'] || headers['x-rd-trace'] || headers['x-forwarded-trace'];
  return tryBase64(raw) || tryHex(raw) || inferFromSpan(headers['span-id']);
}
```
Ibrahim: Pushed TS + unit tests. Added note to avoid synchronous heavy decode in hot loops.
Hannah: Python pushed with pytest for three cases (new, legacy, absent). Mapping formula in docs: `new_bucket = min(12, ceil(old_bucket * 1.2))`.
Priya: Drafted migration blurb and a short monitoring query for unit-cost alerting. Suggest enabling `legacy_bucket_mapping` flag for a short window for Dedicated customers.
Noelle: Link-check request after CI. Also found two old examples pointing to `/examples/old-heatmap`  will coordinate a redirect if needed.
DocsBot: docs-bot: CI passed. link-check: scanned 6 pages, found 1 redirect (old-heatmap).
Noelle: Great. Plan to squash+merge once redirect is in examples repo and then backport a compatibility snippet to `stable-legacy`. Will post a heads-up in #release-war-room before merge.
Priya: I'll prepare the short customer-facing note for Dedicated teams.
Ibrahim: LGTM on TS snippets; will follow up if tests flake.
Noelle: Thanks all  aiming to merge Thu morning after redirect.
